samples.title: Highway traffic (dashcam view)
samples.description: A 20-second highway clip with several cars at different distances, filmed from a moving vehicle. The moving camera makes tracking harder than a fixed camera, which is stated rather than hidden.
samples.attribution: © 2017-2018 Udacity, Inc. Footage from the MIT-licensed repository udacity/CarND-Vehicle-Detection (project_video.mp4), trimmed to 20 s (24-44 s) and re-encoded.
samples.note: We rely on the repository's MIT licence for this footage. No ground-truth vehicle counts are published for it.
